headline.sentence: Nothing to collapse. 9 colors, 11 spacing steps, all on the grid.

drift.narrative: Nothing drifts in this system. It holds nine colors, nine type styles and 11 spacing steps, and every spacing step sits on the grid. No colors sit within reach of a neighbor, no type styles overlap and no component variants need to collapse. The proposed set keeps the same nine type styles and 11 spacing steps, with three grays in the palette. Every pair of text and background keeps its contrast ratio.

exports.designSystemIntro: This design system was extracted from localhost:4100 across nine pages. It holds nine colors, nine type styles, 11 spacing steps and 28 components.
